data.one_liner: Flutter video player plugin based on ijkplayer supporting many protocols and codecs
data.what_it_does: Provides a native video player widget for Android and iOS using ijkplayer. It supports a wide range of streaming protocols and media formats.
use_when: Need high-performance video playback with custom protocols
Require low-level control over playback features
Want to embed a video player widget in a Flutter UI
avoid_when: Using only basic video playback features
Looking for a pure Dart implementation
weaknesses: Plugin size larger than pure Dart alternatives
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, run pod install for iOS, ensure Android Gradle build, no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard Flutter video player with simpler API and simulator support

alternatives.name: video_player_avfoundation
alternatives.why_pick_it: iOS-specific implementation for better iOS performance

alternatives.name: video_player_android
alternatives.why_pick_it: Android-specific implementation for better Android performance
